#!/bin/sh
# worldcradle-managed Factorio server — generated by provision().
# This server's own files: <ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test
. <ROOT>/secrets.conf
python3 - "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/server-settings.json" "$GAME_SERVER_PASSWORD" "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" <<'SYNC'
import json, sys
p, join, admin = sys.argv[1:4]
d = json.load(open(p, encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def put(keys, val):
    obj = d
    for k in keys[:-1]:
        obj = obj.setdefault(k, {})
    obj[keys[-1]] = val
put(['game_password'], join)
json.dump(d, open(p, "w", encoding="utf-8"), indent=2)
SYNC
# first start: create the map
[ -f "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/saves/world.zip" ] || "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/bin/x64/factorio" -c "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/config.ini" --create "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/saves/world.zip" || exit 1
cd "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/" || exit 1
exec ./bin/x64/factorio -c "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/config.ini" --start-server "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/saves/world.zip" \
    --server-settings "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/server-settings.json" \
    --server-adminlist "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/server-adminlist.json" --port 34197 \
    --rcon-bind 127.0.0.1:27070 --rcon-password "$GAME_ADMIN_PASSWORD" \
    --console-log "<ROOT>/installs/factorio/worldcradle-servers/test/console.log"
